title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Seattle University
description: Ten currently documented late-opening food destinations in and around Capitol Hill and First Hill, selected for under-21-safe visits.

cards.title: Lost Lake Cafe
cards.subtitle: 1505 10th Ave, Capitol Hill
cards.notes: Check the day before heading out: the cafe lists midnight closes Sunday–Wednesday, 2 a.m. Thursday, and 3 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.short_summary: A Capitol Hill cafe with the latest listed closing time in this set on Fridays and Saturdays.
cards.evidence_claim: Lost Lake Cafe lists hours of 7 a.m.–midnight Sunday–Wednesday, 7 a.m.–2 a.m. Thursday, and 7 a.m.–3 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Current official hours: Sun–Wed 7 a.m.–midnight; Thu 7 a.m.–2 a.m.; Fri–Sat 7 a.m.–3 a.m. Reconfirm before travel.

cards.title: Dick's Drive-In Broadway
cards.subtitle: 115 Broadway E, Capitol Hill
cards.notes: Use the Broadway location page before leaving; it lists daily service through 2 a.m. and identifies this as the Capitol Hill location.
cards.short_summary: A clearly identified Capitol Hill drive-in with the same late closing time every day.
cards.evidence_claim: Dick's Drive-In's Broadway location is listed as open daily from 10:30 a.m. to 2 a.m.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists daily hours of 10:30 a.m.–2 a.m.; verify holiday changes before going.

cards.title: Big Mario's Capitol Hill
cards.subtitle: 1009 E Pike St, Capitol Hill
cards.notes: Plan around the published schedule: weekday service starts at 11 a.m., weekends at noon, and the Capitol Hill shop lists a 2 a.m. close.
cards.short_summary: A named Capitol Hill pizza location with daily late hours and a later Friday–Saturday slice window.
cards.evidence_claim: Big Mario's lists its Capitol Hill location as open until 2 a.m. daily, with a Friday–Saturday slice window until 3 a.m.
cards.source_title: Big Mario's New York Style Pizza
cards.access_notes: Official site lists Capitol Hill open until 2 a.m. daily; Friday–Saturday slice window is listed 2–3 a.m. Check holiday notices.

cards.title: Olympia Pizza & Spaghetti House 3
cards.subtitle: 212 Broadway E, Capitol Hill
cards.notes: Confirm the kitchen timing if ordering food late: the restaurant lists daily operation until 2 a.m., with the kitchen serving until 1 a.m.
cards.short_summary: A Capitol Hill pizza-and-pasta restaurant whose official page distinguishes its kitchen closing time.
cards.evidence_claim: Olympia Pizza & Spaghetti House 3 lists daily hours of 11 a.m.–2 a.m. and kitchen hours of 11 a.m.–1 a.m.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists the business open daily 11 a.m.–2 a.m.; kitchen listed until 1 a.m. Arrive before kitchen close for food.

cards.title: Pie Bar Capitol Hill
cards.subtitle: 1361 E Olive Way, Capitol Hill
cards.notes: Visit on an operating night and check the site’s closure notices; it lists Tuesday–Thursday 8 p.m.–2 a.m. and Friday–Sunday 5 p.m.–2 a.m.
cards.short_summary: A Capitol Hill pie destination with a late-evening opening schedule rather than daytime service.
cards.evidence_claim: Pie Bar Capitol Hill lists hours until 2 a.m. Tuesday through Sunday, opening at 8 p.m. Tuesday–Thursday and 5 p.m. Friday–Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists 2 a.m. closes Tuesday–Sunday and notes periodic closures; confirm the date before visiting.

cards.title: Momiji
cards.subtitle: 1522 12th Ave, Capitol Hill
cards.notes: Use this for a late dinner on Friday or Saturday: the restaurant’s posted kitchen schedule runs until midnight on those two nights.
cards.short_summary: A 12th Avenue Japanese restaurant with documented midnight weekend kitchen hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Momiji lists kitchen hours of 4 p.m.–midnight Friday and Saturday, and 4–11 p.m. Sunday through Thursday.
cards.access_notes: Official posted kitchen hours reach midnight Friday–Saturday. Confirm reservations and holiday service directly with the restaurant.

cards.title: DeLuxe Bar & Grill
cards.subtitle: 625 Broadway E, Capitol Hill
cards.notes: Check the day-specific schedule before walking over; the restaurant lists Friday and Saturday closing at midnight, later than its weekday service.
cards.short_summary: A longstanding Broadway restaurant with documented midnight Friday and Saturday hours.
cards.evidence_claim: DeLuxe Bar & Grill lists Friday hours of noon–midnight and Saturday hours of 10 a.m.–midnight.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists midnight closing on Friday and Saturday; check the live site for temporary schedule changes.

cards.title: IHOP on East Madison
cards.subtitle: 950 E Madison St, First Hill
cards.notes: Keep the official location page handy for the address and dine-in status; it lists this Seattle restaurant as open 24 hours every day.
cards.short_summary: A First Hill pancake restaurant with official 24-hour daily operation listed.
cards.evidence_claim: IHOP's official Seattle location page lists the restaurant at 950 E Madison St as open 24 hours Monday through Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists 24-hour service every day and identifies dine-in as an amenity. Verify exceptional holiday hours before travel.

cards.title: Chick'N'Crunch Capitol Hill
cards.subtitle: 1525 13th Ave, Capitol Hill
cards.notes: Treat the posted weekend hours as delivery availability and confirm the ordering platform before relying on it; the site lists Saturday and Sunday service until 2 a.m.
cards.short_summary: A 13th Avenue halal chicken-bowl location with published weekend late-night service.
cards.evidence_claim: Chick'N'Crunch states that its Capitol Hill location has weekend late-night service from midnight to 2 a.m. Saturday and Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Official site describes Saturday–Sunday 12–2 a.m. late-night service and links delivery platforms; confirm fulfillment availability before ordering.

cards.title: Dino's Tomato Pie
cards.subtitle: 1524 E Olive Way, Capitol Hill
cards.notes: Plan a Thursday–Saturday food run and recheck the restaurant’s live channels before departure; current local reporting lists a 2 a.m. close those nights.
cards.short_summary: An East Olive Way pizzeria reported to keep later weekend-adjacent hours than its early-week schedule.
cards.evidence_claim: A July 2026 Seattle dining guide reports Dino's Tomato Pie open until midnight Sunday–Wednesday and until 2 a.m. Thursday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: The Best Late-Night Restaurants in Seattle — The Infatuation
cards.access_notes: Current local reporting lists Thursday–Saturday service until 2 a.m.; reconfirm directly with the restaurant for same-night or holiday hours.
